question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled provider plugin in the linked PR, moved to an official external/ClawHub provider package, or left as custom-provider configuration for now?
rationale: The existing provider SDK can express the feature, but adding a first-class hosted provider changes onboarding, auth-choice, catalog, docs, and maintenance ownership surfaces that repository policy treats as a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Resolve Through Linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked draft PR and decide whether its bundled-provider direction is accepted after remaining PR concerns are fixed.

options.title: Move External First
options.body: Ask for the same provider shape as an official external or ClawHub provider package if the core bundle bar is not met yet.

options.title: Keep Custom Configuration
options.body: Decline first-class support for now and rely on documented custom models.providers configuration until demand or ownership changes.

recommendation.title: Resolve Through Linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked draft PR and decide whether its bundled-provider direction is accepted after remaining PR concerns are fixed.
